evals.prompt: Add a small chart to this README section showing weekly downloads over the last five weeks: 120, 340, 210, 505, 480. The README is plain GitHub markdown.
evals.expected_output: A catalog twin (spark/bars family) in a fenced text block with a [ TITLE ] frame, real values, no invented drawing
expectations: The figure is a fenced plain-text block whose first line matches the [ TITLE ] frame grammar
The characters come from a catalog family (track/spark or bars), not an improvised drawing
Contains no Mermaid, SVG, HTML or image figure
The five real values appear as labels/data, not invented numbers

evals.prompt: Our docs site is a React app set up with shadcn. Add an uptime visual for the status page: 42 days, 90% up, 6 degraded days, 2 outages.
evals.expected_output: Registry install (shadcn add of graph-uptime) and JSX usage with props, not pasted text characters
expectations: Recommends or performs a shadcn registry install of the uptime component
Shows JSX usage with props rather than pasting a text twin into the component tree
Contains no Mermaid, SVG or improvised drawing

evals.prompt: Write a short status report section covering six metrics: uptime 99.2%, p95 latency 340ms, error rate 0.4%, deploys 12, MTTR 18min, apdex 0.93. Make it visual.
evals.expected_output: Restraint: at most two figures with prose between, the rest as a table or prose - not six graphs
expectations: No more than two figures appear in the section
Prose or a table carries what figures do not
Any figure present is fenced plain text in a catalog family
